descriptionByLocale.it:
The People Insights & Analytics Intern plays a key role in strengthening the team’s delivery capacity across priority HR insights, capability‑building initiatives, and operational improvement activities. This position ensures continuity, structure, and effective execution within the HR Insights team. You will support the coordination, preparation, and follow‑through of team priorities through communication, content development, process documentation, and workflow support. Operating across team delivery, learning enablement, and process optimization, you will help translate strategic priorities into structured, scalable, and efficient ways of working. What you will get:
• Opportunity to work with a global team and contribute to high-impact projects.
• Mentorship and professional development opportunities. What you will do:
• Support the delivery of priority HR insights, enablement, and operational improvement activities across the team
• Coordinate day-to-day activities, communications, materials, and follow-through to support effective execution of priorities
• Prepare and maintain documentation, presentations, trackers, and stakeholder-facing content to support delivery and continuity
• Contribute to process improvements and the development of practical, scalable, and AI-enabled ways of working
• Support learning, adoption, and enablement activities that help HR stakeholders work more effectively with data, content, and processes What we are looking for:
• Bachelor’s degree (or currently enrolled) in Human Resources, Economics, or a related field
• Strong proficiency in Office 365 tools, especially PowerPoint, good proficiency in Excel
• Excellent organizational and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities in a fast‑paced environment
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail
• Interest in HR data, reporting, insights, and process improvement
• Hands-on interest in using Generative AI tools in a practical and responsible way
• Collaborative and service-oriented working style
• English: Business-fluent proficiency About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
